status: Development baseline; unresolved decisions remain open

items.source_conflict: TRD/roadmap say document alone does not authorise development; master explicitly orders actual build.
items.resolution: Master authorises new development and user-owned private repository/Replit creation. It does not authorise paid upgrades, live finance, confidential production data or public launch.

items.source_conflict: TRD permits assessed existing demo reuse; master requires entirely new application.
items.resolution: Start clean; do not reuse unrelated Valo product code.

items.source_conflict: Roadmap human FTE and 20+8-week estimates versus master primarily AI-agent team.
items.resolution: AI-led implementation with separate review; retain real tests and accountable operational approvals. Dates are estimates, not elapsed-time requirements.

items.source_conflict: Roadmap calls growth provisional/demand gated; master commissions both R1 and R2 but says proceed after R1 acceptance.
items.resolution: R2 remains in assignment; do not call it complete or activate separately gated features before R1 acceptance and applicable gates. Cannot silently drop R2.

items.source_conflict: Essential inventory asks legal review before use; master/TRD replace universal specialist sign-off with evidence-based AI editorial gates.
items.resolution: No routine per-item human/specialist requirement; preserve enhanced checks, held uncertainty and actual licensed-service boundaries.

items.source_conflict: TRD commerce defaults include one-off bundles, R2 expansion also mentions bundles.
items.resolution: R1 may support approved one-off bundles; R2 expands experiments. Recurring subscriptions stay off in R1.

items.source_conflict: TRD main audience is SMEs; master explicitly adds distinct NGO profile and R2 dedicated experience.
items.resolution: Accommodate NGO structure in initial model; implement dedicated R2 experience with structure/activity/jurisdiction-specific guidance.

items.source_conflict: Approximate 80 templates/60 entries are targets, but only R1 40-template list is exact.
items.resolution: Maintain deduplicated backlog and explicit proposed additions; count only eligible usable assets. Do not invent rights/evidence to reach counts.

items.source_conflict: No prices, tax treatment, refund policy or live merchant configuration supplied.
items.resolution: Sandbox only with explicitly nonproduction test values; seek owner decisions on concrete proposed price book/refunds before live operations.

items.source_conflict: Preferred Next.js/Clerk/pg-boss Replit stack is proposed, not proven compatible.
items.resolution: Prove actual deployment, worker, private storage, migrations and restore. Material replacement requires documented architecture decision and owner approval.

items.source_conflict: Documents contain discovery links and explicit retrieval gaps; Essential checklist has citation-like debris, not usable evidence.
items.resolution: Retrieve authoritative operative text and store claim locators/hashes/effectivity. Treat inventory as held research leads until EDP gates pass.

items.source_conflict: Checker public; saving requires verified identity.
items.resolution: Anonymous minimal temporary inputs, no default retention; verified workspace required for durable private data.

items.source_conflict: No verified provider roster, sender domain or support routing supplied.
items.resolution: Do not seed fictional providers or claim messages delivered; service discovery can explain categories with honest empty directory. Real support/ticket and email acceptance remain required.

owner_decisions.proposed_default: Approve R1/R2/R3 boundaries, one-business workspace and the 40-template content floor.
Confirm Replit deployment, storage/database restoration, identity provider and processor geography; approve any replacement adapter.
Set prices, AI allowances, source-checked tax treatment, licence and refunds. Owner accepts terms; no counsel signature is assumed.
owner_decisions.due: Before checkout testing; final before G4

owner_decisions.proposed_default: Configure AI editorial roles, publication policy, evidence gates, six deeper sectors and Lagos/FCT/Bayelsa source priorities; no specialist hiring dependency.
Approve data roles, transfer arrangements, retention, notice and rights/incident procedures.
Approve staffed capacity, operating spend cap and calendar; relative weeks are planning assumptions.
Decide whether R1 lists any providers; approve enquiry handling and future booking commercial model.
